newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: PRESS DIGEST - S.Korean newspapers - Nov 21.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - S.Korean newspapers - Nov 21.

text.p: The following is a summary of major South Korean political stories in leading newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Seoul. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not gaurantee their accuracy. Telephone: (822) 727-5650. Fax: (822) 727-5666.

- President Kim Young-sam, visiting Vietnam on the first leg of a three-nation Southeast Asian tour, agrees with Vietnamese top leader to expand bilateral economic cooperation. Vietnam vows to improve investment conditions for Korean corporations.
- China advises North Korea to press for correct socialist line to market reform, according to the Xinhua news agency
- Expensive consumer good imports during first nine months jumped 28 percent, becoming a major factor contributing to the trade deficit.
- North Korea's latest closure of its liaison office in Panmunjom is apparently due to the office's inability to fulfill its intended function, according to a U.S. state department comment.
- President Kim Young-sam and Do Muoi of Vietnam agree to expand bilateral cooperation at summit talks.
- U.S. plays down North Korea's closure of a border liaison office, saying it was unable to fulfill intended function for inter-Korean contacts.
- Beijing urges Pyongyang to enforce market reform.
